text.en: Pet parents consistently praise the attentive staff at this facility, highlighting individuals like Mariah, Marc, Xavier, and Theresa for their warmth and dedication. Clients appreciate that staff are present on site twenty-four hours a day, providing continuous supervision and personal attention during daycare and extended overnight boarding.

Owners emphasize how happy and relaxed their dogs appear during daycare stays and overnight visits. Reviewers note that dogs receive plenty of playtime, exercise, and affection from handlers. Many clients appreciate that anxious or young puppies adjust quickly and look forward to arriving for group play sessions.

Reviewers highlight the clean condition of the indoor playrooms and boarding areas. Clients particularly value having continuous webcam access, which allows owners to check on their dogs remotely throughout the day. The Lakeshore East and Halsted area location is noted as convenient for daily drop-offs and pickups.

q.en: Is staff present at the facility overnight?

a.en: Yes, reviewers and facility policies confirm that trained staff members remain on site 24 hours a day to monitor boarding pets.

q.en: Can owners monitor their dogs during daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients note that live webcam feeds allow pet parents to check on their animals in the playrooms remotely.

q.en: Does Dog. Hotel | Daycare offer pick-up and drop-off transportation?

a.en: Yes, reviewers specifically highlight coordinated shuttle transportation services that simplify morning and evening routines.
